title: A 1,2-hydride shift
caption: A secondary carbocation next to a carbon bearing a hydrogen and two methyl groups rearranges: the C–H bonding pair moves, with the hydrogen, to the C⁺. The positive charge moves to the neighbouring carbon, which is now tertiary and more stable.
alt: Two stages: the 3-methylbutan-2-yl cation with a curly arrow from the neighbouring C–H bond to the positive carbon; the tertiary 2-methylbutan-2-yl cation.
description: Stage 1: secondary cation; a curly arrow from the C–H bond on the next carbon towards C⁺.
Stage 2: the hydrogen has moved; the positive charge is on the carbon bearing two methyl groups, a tertiary cation.
